citations.locator: Ethiopian Evangelical Church Mekane Yesus, member profile
citations.excerpt: From these joint efforts the Ethiopian Evangelical Church Mekane Yesus (EECMY) was instituted as a national church in 1959.

facts.value: An Ethiopian church that grew from Ethiopian Christians preaching with the help of Lutheran missions. Its name, from its first congregation in Addis Ababa, means Place of Jesus.

citations.excerpt: At the turn of the 19th century, Ethiopian Christians began proclaiming the gospel with the help of the Lutheran missions in the country.
It takes its name from its first congregation in Addis Ababa, Mekane Yesus, meaning the "Place of Jesus".

facts.value_before_verify: An Ethiopian church that grew from Ethiopian evangelists working with Lutheran missions. Its name means Place of Jesus.
